blocker: The remaining inference is that the properly based warranted response counts for its bearer without a relevant end or sound practical connection. Structural eligibility and warrant do not supply that authority; using a stronger Reason or Warrant interpretation would assume it. No different test remains in this reconstruction. Further work requires a substantive new argument, mechanism or consequence that discriminates on this exact relevance question, not a new predicate or another success measure. Preserve prior qualified judgments and propose allocation to another open root node after review. The separate actual-case application still needs its previously specified episode evidence. The local belief-witness question has a separate application test: establish the accuracy aim, receipt of a parity-sensitive tally and its pro tanto bearing on this answer. If the observed pair count is equally likely conditional on even and on odd, a report that omits the residue favors neither answer, though it can give the investigator a reason to check the residue. Neither assent nor an end-independent force premise is required for the local route.

current_assessment.scope: Issue #1007. Which actual-force concessions yield a reason to believe a particular content in the same subject and reason relation?
current_assessment.assessment: A consideration attributed specifically to believing p supplies a thin reason for that same subject and content under reverse presentation. Force at any or all preferences for withholding about p leaves that belief witness open. The accuracy-directed account can grant a reason to believe when evidence favors an answer and the investigator seeks accuracy. This leaves its dispute with preference-independent authority open.
current_assessment.next_test: For the same investigator and parity question, establish whether the received tally included the unpaired residue. A pair count whose likelihood is the same under even and odd leaves their prior odds unchanged. An accurate copy of a checked tally can transmit its discriminating information.
